    • getFirePower

      public int getFirePower()
      Gets the total firepower provided by this double cannon. When activated, provides double the normal firepower of a standard cannon.
      Overrides:
      getFirePower in class Cannon
      Returns:
      4 if facing up and activated, 2 if facing another direction and activated, or normal cannon firepower (i.e., 0) if not activated
